title: Ship-Now History and Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Spacing
content:
Ship-now shipments shorten the dosing days between shipments of an Autoship Pharmacy or Autoship Compounded Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship. The count is of ship-now shipments charged on that subscription.

- Two or more ship-now shipments charged on the subscription in the last twelve months: 6 days are taken away.
- Exactly one: 3 days are taken away.
- None: no days are taken away.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

Scheduled shipments, replacement shipments and ship-now requests that were never charged do not count.

| Hypothetical history over the last twelve months | Days taken away |
|---|---|
| One ship-now shipment charged three months ago | 3 |
| Two ship-now shipments charged, eleven and one months ago | 6 |
| One ship-now shipment charged exactly twelve months ago, none since | none |
